dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular elliptical and circular perimeters defined by high-intensity pixel boundaries surrounding lower-intensity centers. The edges exhibit a stippled geometry with a sharp gradient transition between the bright boundary and the dark interior, forming closed 'O' and open 'C' shapes.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentration of small, high-intensity punctate clusters observed on the posterior lateral surface and hind flippers. Additional lower-density, solid-intensity clusters are distributed between the larger annuli structures along the central flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest mid-lateral annuli form a scalene triangular relationship. Centroids of the four most distal high-intensity blobs on the hind flipper define a narrow, vertically-oriented trapezoidal formation relative to the dorsal axis.
